summary: End-to-end encrypted conversations, so a leaked database or a curious administrator reveals nothing.

features.title: End-to-end encrypted chats
features.short: Messages the server itself cannot read
features.description: Once the administrator switches encryption on, people using Chat through Apps Hub can choose for every direct chat and group whether it is encrypted. Messages are encrypted in the browser before they are sent and stored only as ciphertext, so neither the server nor a stolen database can reveal what was written.

features.title: Encrypt every new chat
features.short: One personal switch instead of a choice each time
features.description: Each person can decide that all of their new chats start encrypted, and can still override it for a single conversation. Regular and encrypted chats live side by side, and existing chats stay exactly as they were.

features.title: Personal passphrase and recovery code
features.short: Every person guards their own keys
features.description: Each person protects their keys with a passphrase of their own that never leaves the device, and receives a recovery code to save. Both can be changed later, and the keys can be reset if everything is lost, which makes older encrypted messages unreadable.

features.title: Automatic key changes for groups
features.short: Members joining or leaving never share old keys
features.description: When someone is added to or removed from an encrypted group, or resets their own keys, the conversation moves to a fresh key automatically. New members read only what is written after they join, and people who left cannot read anything new.

features.title: Security codes
features.description: Every person has a short security code that can be compared through another channel such as a phone call. If a contact's code ever changes, Chat asks before sending anything further, and notifications for encrypted chats never reveal the message text.

features.title: Administrator control
features.short: Switch it on or off in the app settings
features.description: The administrator turns encryption on or off from the settings button in the Chat window. When it is off, people simply do not see the option, and chats that are already encrypted stay locked until it is switched back on. Regular chats are never affected.
